quantity: Joint smoking/vaping/former-use state occupancy and intensity
remaining_limit: Aggregate prevalence exists; no compatible joint covariance or catchment-period intensity distribution.
next_public_only_action: Use existing official survey records; seek published joint tables and exact population/period definitions. Do not turn overlapping marginals into disjoint people.

quantity: Time-aligned lawful consumption and stock/visitor flows
candidate_sources: Existing Ministry returns and supply ledger
remaining_limit: Releases, purchases and resident consumption are different; all eight matched cells are still unsupported.
next_public_only_action: Reconcile public returns, trade and published stock adjustments in native units; use partial-identification bounds where justified.

quantity: Sample-date wastewater flow and contributing population
remaining_limit: Published normalised loads do not supply the dated normalisers needed for independent reconstruction.
next_public_only_action: Search supplementary/public catchment metadata without replacing catchment population by settlement population.

quantity: Effective detection/censoring thresholds, recovery and sewer loss
remaining_limit: Method limits alone do not establish sample-specific processed censoring or recovery.
next_public_only_action: Retain censored observations and seek public raw-method calibrations; no zero or half-limit imputation without a specified model.

quantity: Target biological yield and product attribution
candidate_sources: Existing Weng and 0.91/1.13 microgram calibration scenarios
remaining_limit: Available foreign selected-sample factors do not identify NZ yields; an untyped spread is not a standard error.
next_public_only_action: Use separately labelled factors; calibrate uncertainty only from a suitable published sample/distribution. NRT/vape/pouch contributions remain explicit.

quantity: Shared-source covariance and serial dependence
remaining_limit: Source identities identify possible dependence, not its numerical covariance.
next_public_only_action: Retain cohort/occasion groups and use transparent dependence challenges; no independent sampling of related ratios, arms or subgroup estimates.

quantity: Causal response to the prospective approximately 600-retailer restriction
remaining_limit: Treatment trials and denicotinisation beliefs do not identify this different intervention.
next_public_only_action: Complete existing public-only review for target-relevant access effects; retain null/transport alternatives. Do not substitute VLNC effects for retail effects.

quantity: Age/product/history-specific initiation, relapse and transition hazards
remaining_limit: Fixed-horizon abstinence is not an annual Markov transition; current/former categories conceal duration and relapse.
next_public_only_action: Obtain compatible published longitudinal tables; fit only identifiable transition combinations and preserve probability conservation.

quantity: Contemporary NZ joint demand, pass-through and illicit supplier response
remaining_limit: Historical NZ estimates and external model settings exist; modern sampling uncertainty, asymmetric responses and endogeneity remain.
next_public_only_action: Use historical and comparator blocks separately, then seek public current product-level prices/quantities and credible policy contrasts.

quantity: Compatible never-smoker absolute disease and mortality hazards
remaining_limit: Relative hazards do not supply absolute hazards; population life tables already mix smoking statuses.
next_public_only_action: Use matched age/sex baseline rates and a reviewed mixture decomposition; avoid multiplying total-population mortality directly by smoker HR.

quantity: Cessation-risk decay, exposure memory and long-term vaping risk
remaining_limit: No annual time-since-quitting risk function or validated vaping-to-disease mapping extracted here.
next_public_only_action: Use published disease-specific lag evidence; test semi-Markov risk memory. Never assume harm proportional to nicotine or a universal vaping risk percentage.

quantity: Joint disease utilities, NZ tariff mapping and causal decrements
remaining_limit: Australian marginal prevalent-condition utilities overlap; no NZ-specific joint-state tariff or transition utility effect supplied.
next_public_only_action: Use Australian scenario estimates within their scope; recover full subgroup tables/covariance and verify any scoring licence separately.

quantity: Incremental surveillance, policy, enforcement and delivery costs
remaining_limit: ED associations and national budgets are not the incremental costs of a wastewater study or retailer intervention.
next_public_only_action: Use public unit costs, procurement records and resource counts; specify currency/year/perspective. Report cost ceilings when true incremental costs are missing.

quantity: ED cost price year, adjustment and conversion to avoidable resource use
remaining_limit: Abstract has AUD estimates and intervals but no price year; subgroup contrast is not causal savings.
next_public_only_action: Obtain public full-text costing methods before inflation/conversion or cessation-savings claims. Keep source year unknown rather than assuming publication year.

quantity: Disjoint subgroup populations, heterogeneous effects and displaced health
remaining_limit: Overlapping social/disease strata do not identify joint groups or ethically chosen weights.
next_public_only_action: Recover published joint denominators and evaluate explicit alternative equity objectives without inventing preference probabilities.

quantity: Independent target outcomes and prespecified temporal/catchment coverage
remaining_limit: Derived ABS/ITEC outputs share inputs; six-month Kim campaign does not meet existing validation rules.
next_public_only_action: Keep the frozen minimums; compare methods descriptively until eligible public independent outcomes exist. Report unavailable scores as unavailable, not zero.

quantity: Perspective, health/cost trade-offs and normative weights
remaining_limit: A discount convention does not identify willingness to pay, equity priorities, criminal harm valuation or policy authority.
next_public_only_action: Keep perspectives separate and publish decision regions or Pareto sets; do not treat normative disagreements as random biological parameters.

quantity: Complete dated legal baseline including Australian excise
remaining_limit: NZ January notice is verified as a dated edition; current Australian rate values were not independently verified in this pass.
next_public_only_action: Use authoritative dated schedules; do not promote media quotes or PBO model prices to statutory rates. Confirm later amendments before operational use.

quantity: Comprehensive executable parameter-to-evidence inventory
candidate_sources: This candidate registry;existing bounded M2 provenance
remaining_limit: This targeted registry does not enumerate every literal, configuration field, prior support or dynamic array in the repository.
next_public_only_action: Extract code/config parameters, link aliases and units to evidence IDs, and require explicit coverage labels. Do not infer complete code coverage from 65 rows.

quantity: Original-source bytes and target-specific evidence admission
remaining_limit: Connector/web review is not independent original-byte readback or canonical archive registration.
next_public_only_action: Reuse existing source archive/admission machinery and preserve public-only permissions. Native software acceptance remains separate from empirical relevance.
